_description: Output of the target-blind CORE (PerturbationRelation + VerdictComparator). Computed deterministically from TWO nwave.test_result.v1 (baseline + perturbed). It is a DATUM with a frozen envelope, NOT a port. The verdict is NEVER declared by an LLM.

deterministic_rule._note: Computed by the CORE only — mai LLM.
deterministic_rule.GREEN: baseline.passed > 0 AND baseline.failed == 0 AND (perturbed.failed > 0 OR perturbed.exit_code != 0)   [flippa = onesto]  reason=verdict-flipped
deterministic_rule.RED: baseline verde AND perturbed ANCORA verde   [theater]   reason=theater-held
deterministic_rule.ABSTAIN: seam non nominabile OR runner assente OR baseline non-verde   [fail-safe]   reason=no-nameable-seam|runner-absent|baseline-not-green
